title: App-Ads-Mass-Inspector Input
description: Array of developer entries to inspect for app-ads.txt compliance.

developer_url.description: Developer or publisher domain used as record identifier.

app_ads_content.description: Raw text content of the app-ads.txt file. Newline-delimited. May contain comment lines (starting with #) and blank lines.
examples:
google.com, pub-1234567890123456, DIRECT, f08c47fec0942fa0
adcolony.com, 12345, DIRECT
